title: Influence investigation of powder compound compositions on pressing process
abstract: Carrying out of studies and their results concerning the influence of the powder compound composition on mechanical properties of complete pyrotechnic products are discussed. A multicomponent powder compound has been made which included powders of aluminum, graphite, chalk, resin and ethyl alcohol. Comparative results of strength of the studied powder compound and strength of powder of aluminum and graphite after pressing are presented. It is shown that the properties of studied compound and original materials are different.
